[h1]Halcyon Drift[/h1]

Command a lone starship on the edge of known space. Captain Vega must scavenge wrecks, outwit pirates, and keep the crew alive across a procedurally generated galaxy.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Deep ship-building with hundreds of modules
[*]Permadeath roguelike campaigns
[*]A reactive story that remembers your choices
[/list]

Wishlist now and join the drift.
english.app[content][short_description]: A brutal space-survival roguelike. Scavenge, fight, and keep your crew alive across a living galaxy.
